one_sentence: The post-Flood patriarchal lifespan decline follows a quantum decoherence equation with an asymptotic floor, implying grace prevents total coherence collapse.
executive_summary: This document establishes a structural isomorphism between quantum decoherence and the decline of post-Flood patriarchal lifespans in Genesis 11. The core claim is that lifespans decay exponentially with a nonzero floor, mirroring the decoherence curve of a quantum system coupled to a persistent external coherence source (grace). Key evidence includes an exponential+floor model fitting 14 post-Flood data points with R²=0.888 and p=4.73×10⁻⁷, outperforming five alternative models by ΔAIC=5.3. The asymptotic floor converges independently from four sources: the regression, Psalm 90:10, modern WHO data, and the Genesis 6:3 ceiling. The conclusion is that this isomorphism passes all four separator tests (structural preservation, non-arbitrariness, constraint, bidirectionality), warranting Level 3 classification.
short_summary: This document is a structural isomorphism paper mapping quantum decoherence to post-Flood lifespan decline in Genesis 11. The core claim is that lifespans decay exponentially with an asymptotic floor, exactly as a decohering quantum system does when coupled to a persistent external source. Key evidence includes a best-fit exponential+floor model (R²=0.888, p=4.73×10⁻⁷) and four independent convergences on the floor value. This matters because it suggests a physical law (decoherence) is mirrored in theological data, with grace as the coherence-preserving agent.
